discoveryText: NASA's Voyager 1 probe is now one light-day away after 49 years travelling through space.
b12502 CUDA: use MMQ for MoE on V100 (#32504). Specific kernel optimization.
Refactor one attention kernel loop and adjust a unit test. No new user-facing feature.
Merged Lemonade PR adds an OpenAI-compatible image generation endpoint to the desktop app. Available on main; not yet in a tagged release.
GAIA feature release adds local document search agents and support for new Ryzen AI devices.
NVIDIA releases an open-source local speech model toolkit, adding multilingual transcription and a documented consumer GPU deployment path.
Hugging Face announces a new open-weight small reasoning model designed for low-memory local inference, with released weights and reproducible evaluations.
Intel launches a new desktop AI processor competing with AMD Ryzen AI, with a larger NPU and announced memory capacity and shipping availability.
Pi 1.0 launches as a stable coding agent, alongside Pi Durable for long-running agents.
Nous launches Hermes Desktop, bringing its persistent agent to macOS, Windows and Linux.
Agent v1.0.1 fixes a CLI log formatter and updates an internal dependency. No new capability.
Tutorial: configure three callbacks and a custom tool handler in an existing agent SDK.
JetBrains launches a new coding model and makes its autonomous coding service generally available.
IntelliJ patch fixes a settings dialog alignment bug. No product or service launch.
